常规的通过回调触发对话框的弹出。.en-us: Open a dialog from a callback.

设置参数`renderFooter=True`后，会在对话框底部渲染自带的操作按.en-us: Set `renderFooter=True` to display the dialog's built-in footer buttons.

通过相关的一系列参数对底部操作区的取消、确认按钮进行自定义调整。.en-us: Customize the footer's Cancel and Confirm buttons through the related settings.

通过参数`width`控制对话框宽度。.en-us: Use `width` to set the dialog width.

参数`width`支持传入字典型，以设置不同页面宽度断点下的响应式对话框宽度。.en-us: Pass a dictionary to `width` to configure responsive dialog widths at different viewport breakpoints.

设置参数`centered=True`后，对话框将垂直居中显示。.en-us: Set `centered=True` to center the dialog vertically.

设置参数`loading=True`为对话框内容区开启加载中状态。.en-us: Set `loading=True` to show the dialog content as loading.

设置参数`confirmAutoSpin=True`后，确认按钮每次被点击后都会.en-us: Set `confirmAutoSpin=True` to put the confirmation button into a loading state after each click. For callbacks that take time, restore it with `confirmLoading=False` after completion.

通过回调函数监听对话框常用事件。.en-us: Monitor common dialog events through callbacks.

设置参数`preventClose=True`后，对话框将不会被用户手动操作关闭.en-us: Set `preventClose=True` to prevent manual dialog closing, for example to implement a confirmation step before closing.
